veranderings.voor: Die dans is na daardie stewels genoem
veranderings.na: Die dans is na daardie stewels vernoem
veranderings.rede: 'Na iets genoem' calques English 'named after'; the Afrikaans idiom is 'na iets vernoem'.

veranderings.blok: Gumboot-dans: hoe dit lyk en klink
veranderings.voor: volg die span dikwels die maat
veranderings.na: volg die span dikwels die ritme
veranderings.rede: 'Die maat volg' can be read as 'follow the partner', since the glossary uses 'maat' for a partner; 'ritme' is the lesson's own word for the beat and keeps the meaning.
'Dikwels' appears three times in this short block; 'baie keer' means the same and keeps the qualifier while varying the wording.

veranderings.voor: Dit is die klem en nie
veranderings.na: Dit is elke dans se klem en nie
veranderings.rede: The bare 'Dit' has no clear referent after two sentences about two dances; naming whose emphasis it is makes the reference clear without adding content.
'n Dans dans' repeats the same word as noun and verb and reads clumsily; the passive says the same thing smoothly.

veranderings.na: soos daardie karakter dit sou doen.
veranderings.rede: Ending on the bare modal 'sou' copies English 'as that character would'; Afrikaans completes the verb phrase.

vlae.blok: Drie punte om na 'n dans te kyk
vlae.teks: hoe die liggaam beweeg en waarop gedans word
vlae.rede: 'Waarop gedans word' can be read as the surface danced on rather than the music danced to; the later block says 'die musiek waarop hulle dans', but which is meant here cannot be fixed without guessing the intended content.
